note: The bank on Diego Garcia, in the British Indian Ocean Territory, is Community Bank, the US Department of Defense's overseas banking programme (its site's description says it is DoD-owned, run under contract by a commercial financial institution, with banking centers in Diego Garcia among other places; its page names 'NFCU - Overseas Military Banking Program' as the institution receiving incoming wires). Its locations page (read 2026-10-30) lists the Diego Garcia banking center at the U.S. Navy Support Facility, building 132, and its basic banking page gives the US routing number, 051005504, and the customer's account number as what's needed to make or receive ACH payments. So an account held in the territory is numbered in the United States' form. Community Bank serves only the customers its contract authorises (US forces, their families, contractors); no other bank in the territory was found, and the territory's own administration wasn't read on it.
